findings.title: Security (surface 5): injection
findings.body:
Reachability: Feishu im.message.receive_v1 field `event.message.content` -> unmarshaled at service/feishu_finance_agent.go:319-320 -> persisted as `action.RawText` (line 334, re-read at line 350) -> passed to the LLM command parser `parseFeishuFinanceAgentCommand(ctx, text)` at line 359 -> LLM-derived fields (TargetAccount, CommissionRatePercent, GiftCredits, WithdrawEnabled) become `feishuFinanceAgentPlan` at line 392 -> executed as privileged writes `model.AddAffPromotionUsers` at line 686 and `model.GrantAdminCredits` at line 695 once a root operator confirms via `HandleFeishuFinanceAgentCard` (line 449); the stale-parsing sweep also re-feeds stored RawText to the LLM at line 867
Note: Prompt injection into an LLM engine that parameterizes root-level financial writes: chat text (including third-party content the whitelisted operator pastes or quotes, as the file's own threat-model comment at line 31 acknowledges) decides the target account, commission rate and credit amount, so an injected instruction can make the stored plan diverge from the operator's stated intent. Mitigations exist but do not break the path: sender whitelist + live root-role check (lines 299, 474, 262), 500-rune cap (line 324), deterministic numeric bounds in buildFeishuFinanceAgentPlan (lines 177-238), injection-hint regexes surfaced as a warning on the card (lines 57-93, 400), and a human confirm step on a current->new value card; execution itself is limited to the two idempotent model calls.
findings.recommendation: Fix the issue, or provide evidence that the path is not reachable.
